svg.title: Key plan, sheet G-000: a floor plan of the work. 5 rooms off one corridor, one per domain, AI & LLM systems (7 sheets: AURIXA, ReBo, GHDA-SaaS, OCR-LLM-DIST, ai-automation, JobSlave, OCR-LocalLLM); Vision, edge & desktop (4 sheets: Vigilix, DADM, FlowState, KeepMeAwake); Data & platforms (4 sheets: AIDA, RestroScraper, TracePulse, shelf); Web & product (6 sheets: MirrorState, akshaybajpai.com, medhathapliyal.site, aiximius.com, ew-dashboard, Merakiel.in); Research notebooks (7 sheets: Alzheimer's thesis, Anime-face GAN, Chinese MNIST CNN, Tweet sentiment RNN, Stock-price GRU, Cervical risk classifier, Hangman solver). A camera visits each room in turn and its light comes on, while someone in the corridor walks to its door.

g.text: Every room is a domain; every line in it, a sheet.
a site as a drawing set
